description: This file is a script for running and monitoring a build/watch process, including argument parsing, directory snapshotting, external command execution, and generating reports and summaries. It appears to be part of a build infrastructure or regression testing suite for a larger project.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments based on default options and updates the options object accordingly.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parent directories if they do not exist.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes to normalize file paths.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Lists all entries in a directory tree starting from the given root, returning a sorted list of relative paths.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Generates a snapshot of the directory tree, including counts of files, directories, symlinks, and total size.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a directory snapshot including paths and statistics to a specified directory.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Runs a command synchronously and throws an error if the command fails.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command object to run the watch process with timing, platform-specific.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Parses a timing log file to extract user, system, and elapsed seconds.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Runs a watch process with timeout and signal handling, tracking timing and output.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads a list of paths from a file into an array.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Computes differences between two snapshots and writes added and removed paths to files.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs a failure message to stderr.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Analyzes stdout and stderr logs to determine the reason for a build trigger.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Prepares environment variables and paths for run-node dependency resolution.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function orchestrating the build, watch process, snapshotting, reporting, and validation logic.
